title: **Request for Information - Market Intelligence Survey** Use of OTA for E-7 Squad Ops Facility - Tinker AFB, OK
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SWD > W076 ENDIST TULSA
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Tulsa District is issuing this Market Intelligence Survey. The 552 Air Control Wing Commander has a requirement to establish a secure facility for mission planning in support of bringing new capabilities to the E-3 Sentry Aircraft and E-7 Wedgetail and to relocate the 963rd and 964th operational airborne warning and control system flying squadrons. The intent is to provide a properly configured and sized facility to support multiple combat-coded squadrons with the required infrastructure and security levels to sustain combat mission readiness, training, and computer network/hardware requirements. This includes planning and executing combat training events with current, fourth-, and fifth-generation aircraft from the air and on land in direct support of the 23A system, ground control and reporting centers, and E-3/E-7 airborne warning and control system missions.
